restaurantName: Wild Heart Bar & Shokudo at Sanctum Soho Hotel
bio: Treat yourself to a Japanese-inspired Afternoon Tea at Wild Heart Bar & Shokudo, housed inside the impressive Sanctum Soho Hotel.  New for the summer, the Japanese-inspired afternoon tea at Karma Sanctum Soho will be served on their exclusive roof terrace with outdoor and indoor seating, followed by a flight of cocktails!  The  Japanese-inspired Afternoon Tea is a unique take on the classic British tradition with savoury dishes such as chicken katsu sliders, steamed vegetable gyozas, and sweet treats, including matcha pannacotta with freeze-dried raspberries and mini yuzu and red fruit tarts.  End your experience with a decedent flight of mini cocktails and matching macaroons, including a high octane Jack Daniel’s Espresso Martini, a zesty Classic Margarita, and sweet Chambord shot.  Afternoon Tea with a cocktail flight is priced at £44 per person.  Looking for something a bit different? Why not swap traditional finger sandwiches and cakes for delicious gyozas and mochi a Japanese-inspired Gentleman's Afternoon Tea at Sanctum Soho Hotel. Gentleman's Afternoon Tea is priced at £30 per person.  Sanctum Soho Hotel is located in one of the most upmarket and bustling areas of London, within easy reach of many of the city's main attractions.
